title: Scheme-theoretic closure
statement:
Let $a\colon T\to Y$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated immersion.
Define the scheme-theoretic closure of $T$ in $Y$ to be the closed
subscheme $\operatorname{SIm}(a)\hookrightarrow Y$.

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line: for the given quasi-compact quasi-separated immersion a, take a.image with inclusion a.imageι. Hom.image at Subscheme.lean:662 is a.ker.subscheme; Hom.imageι at :665 is a.ker.subschemeι. The IsClosedImmersion instance in Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Morphisms/ClosedImmersion.lean:94-95 applies with I := a.ker and supplies the closed-subscheme clause. Both definitions are available for arbitrary scheme morphisms and require no extra hypotheses. Hom.ker in Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/IdealSheaf/Basic.lean:693-694 is the largest quasi-coherent ideal in the sheaf-map kernel; Hom.ker_apply at :702-703 identifies its affine sections with the actual kernel under the given quasi-compactness hypothesis. This is exactly SIm(a) of the current blueprint.
